continue_rule: Only a pass of exactness, shell theorem, codebook-free execution, and strong-baseline competitiveness authorizes the final novelty and real-impairment gate.
narrow_rule: If the theorem closes but the membership-only decoder is not competitive with the strong exact baseline, retain only a foundations/boundary paper and stop the field-defining investment.
scientific_scope: decisive revised-track gate after the v1 computational signal; not a novelty proof or real-system validation
stop_rule: If the code-specific syndrome-trellis baseline dominates by more than 5x in every primary largest-n configuration, or exactness/theorem checks fail, stop the field-defining programme immediately.
